Name: JAC'd - Barns
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b]Just Another Custom Deluxe: Barns

[UPDATE]

[/b]It's been about 5 years now but I've finally updated this mod! Thanks to PathosChild for all the assistance in getting my feet grounded in Content Patcher to finally bring you an updated version! Currently the attic is inaccessible due to just running through to get things functioning properly with a rough edit but I will be updating this soon enough to fix that, surely. 

[b][OLD NEWS][/b]

Upon upgrading my barn to the final size I realized I didn't like it. Long ago I searched for a bigger, better barn and found that- only it seemed waaay to unrealistically HUGE and I didn't really like the way it was all laid out. I lived with it for a time simply because I didn't want to work with the Coop tilesheet. Low and behold I decided to dig into it a little bit and create a slight alternate tilesheet to add that will make things fit a little better. I thought having the trough as just a long set of boards looked dull. There are still a few things I'd like to fix, possibly make it even smaller. I plan take some tiles out and add some more customs later on but for now I figured since I had a working version already packed up I would throw it up here. Feel free to suggest any changes you would like to see! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FGcbkhzl.jpg[/img]

[b][Update]:[/b] Added Medium Barns (barns2.xnb). Tilesheet was also updated.
